cc:Work.dc:title: Two B200 GPUs · Qwen3.8-Flash-Next BF16 · one pod
cc:Work.dc:description: On one pod, prefill CUDA graphs raise stock SGLang MTP3 and AX Engine MTP7 to stock vLLM MTP3's level at four and sixteen clients; AX MTP7 leads code at one and four clients.
